latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skill-prescan: simulate ClawHub’s security review for SKILL.md files locally.

- Enables local pre-scan of SKILL.md with the same prompt and evaluation criteria as ClawHub’s ClawScan security review.
- Supports OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic providers, with custom model and endpoint options.
- Outputs security verdicts and findings mirroring ClawHub, helping identify concerns before publishing.
- Includes environment variable and CLI argument support for configuration.
- Provides guidance for interpreting results and improving skill documentation.
